TASK_3A_BRIDGE.what: repurposing_bridge.py gains (1) label_lookup with status MATCH_FOUND / NO_MATCH_FOUND / QUERY_ERROR / NOT_ATTEMPTED and an independent coverage axis COMPLETE_FOR_QUERIES_RUN / COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE / UNKNOWN, with per-state limit lines and validation (a concluded search must list its queries, NOT_ATTEMPTED must not; MATCH_FOUND needs product identity or SPL id; QUERY_ERROR needs the error; COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE needs its limit; unknown fields refused); (2) p4_fields with endpoint_pursued, functional_evidence_available, temporal_or_model_limit and a cellular_context of target_expression / cells_tissue_stage / coverage / limits, always present and UNKNOWN rather than absent; (3) abstention NO_DRUG_ASSERTIONS_SUPPLIED, so an empty assertion list is a different fact from a search that returned nothing.
TASK_3A_BRIDGE.discipline_preserved: no network, no lookup performed, no state inferred, no ranking, no score, no promotion; an outcome never moves directional_summary, assessment or comparisons, and NO_MATCH_FOUND neither drops a candidate nor becomes biological counterevidence. Card stays IPOTESI / canonical false.
TASK_3A_BRIDGE.docs: .claude/skills/legend-hypothesis-forge/references/evidence_bridge.md records the two new optional blocks and their limits

TASK_3B_RESCUE_SCAFFOLD.what: the five endpoint families (excitability/EEG, myelination, neuroinflammation/gliosis, growth/metabolism, survival/function), each demanding figure/table, model, control, age, intervention, direction, duration and limits. Pre-filled only with what the roadmap itself attributes to Obeid et al.; every such cell marked TRANSCRIBED_FROM_ROADMAP + UNVERIFIED_BY_THIS_RECORD; unfilled cells marked NOT_YET_BOUND, which is reading debt and not a negative result.
TASK_3B_RESCUE_SCAFFOLD.receipt_check_outcome: the task's premise 'this repository has no reading of that paper unless fulltext_receipts.py status --pmid says otherwise' was tested and says otherwise: 12 receipts exist. The scaffold therefore routes the filler to the receipted reading and its locators rather than to the roadmap, and names three divergences to resolve first (dose-dependent vs threshold per CLAIM 011's flag; the undeclared dose-unit convention, factor of two with an invariant HD/LD ratio; which endpoints the complete read resolved and in which direction).
TASK_3B_RESCUE_SCAFFOLD.limits_stated: not Q230P evidence (Wwox-null full knockout, neither the missense allele nor a compound heterozygote) and not a reusable RNA-seq rescue signature (the primary's data availability is 'not relevant'; GSE156243 is a knockout-versus-wild-type organoid contrast, not this study's rescue arm). Not medical advice; no dose or administration for any person.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: the two deliverables are in Italian and repository files are written in English

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: the reconciliation was a required deliverable of the same task; the gate was satisfied by completing the work, not by loosening anything
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.different_if: the reconciliation had been out of scope, the pointer would have been dropped

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: the task said the repository has no reading of Obeid et al. unless the receipt tool says otherwise
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: ran the check, found 12 receipts including a complete read, and wrote the scaffold around the reading instead of around the roadmap
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: it corrects a premise downward in confidence about the external document and upward about the repository; no scientific content was authored by Harness Engineering
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.different_if: the receipts had been absent, every cell would have been NOT_YET_BOUND with no route but re-acquisition

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: the roadmap's pathograph figures might have been stale and the instruction was to correct them

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: the instruction was to measure, and a confirmed figure is a measurement result
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.different_if: a drift had appeared, the measured number would stand beside the quoted one

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: the release battery's first run died silently at 90 of 149 targets: it had been launched as `nohup ... &` inside a backgrounded shell, and the child was killed when that launcher exited
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: re-ran the whole battery with the runner itself as the background command's foreground process, so its lifetime is the task's, and read the verdict from the completion notification rather than from a name-matching poll
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: a battery is idempotent and the second run covered every target; no partial result was reported as a verdict
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.different_if: the first run's 90 clean targets had been reported as the battery result, which would have been a verdict over a run that never finished. Hindsight default, and it generalises: wait on a job by PID:START or a completion file with framework/scripts/process_wait.py, never by process name — `pgrep -f run_release_regressions` also matched two other actors' waiter shells in this very window, which is exactly why the death looked like progress

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: the session stopped on a rate limit mid-closeout and resumed the next day; by then a parallel actor had written its own files into this task's directory and corrected the manifest row this record had reported as overstated
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: checked durable state first (branch, worktree, directory contents, task record), kept every existing file untouched, folded the other actor's census in as a measured input with its commit SHA, and dated the verdicts that moved instead of rewriting them
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: nothing was redone and nothing of the peer's was overwritten; a reconciliation that silently updates its own verdicts stops being a measurement
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.different_if: re-running the census would have cost a second set of live queries and produced a second record of the same fact

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: legend_lint's EVIDENCE_AVAILABILITY line differs between the root checkout and a linked worktree
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: report the difference as an artefact of the worktree lacking the gitignored files/ tree, and re-run LINT in the root checkout after landing
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: no receipt, manifest or artefact was touched; the digest-mismatch count is 0 in both runs
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.different_if: a digest mismatch had appeared, it would be a finding rather than an environment note

DECISIONS_TAKEN.what: label_lookup carries the query outcome and the coverage on two independent axes rather than one five-valued enum
DECISIONS_TAKEN.alternatives_rejected: a single enum including COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE as a sibling of NO_MATCH_FOUND
DECISIONS_TAKEN.who_consulted: the roadmap's own text ('Un risultato può essere NO_MATCH_FOUND con copertura incompleta: tenere separati esito della query e copertura')
DECISIONS_TAKEN.how_to_revert: revert the bridge commit; no stored data depends on the shape

DECISIONS_TAKEN.what: unknown keys in label_lookup, p4_fields and cellular_context are refused with ValueError instead of being retained
DECISIONS_TAKEN.alternatives_rejected: keep unknown keys, as the raw input packet already does
DECISIONS_TAKEN.why: the raw packet is preserved verbatim under input anyway, so nothing is lost; refusing in the normalised block is what stops a typo becoming a field and stops a weight or score being smuggled into a tool whose whole discipline is that it does not score

DECISIONS_TAKEN.what: no lookup is performed and no state is inferred: label_lookup is declared by the caller
DECISIONS_TAKEN.alternatives_rejected: let the bridge call openFDA directly, which would have been easy and reachable
DECISIONS_TAKEN.why: the tool's stated discipline is that it has no network; a bridge that queries becomes a client whose failure modes the card can no longer describe honestly

DECISIONS_TAKEN.what: the rescue scaffold states the divergence between the roadmap's 'dose-dependent' and CLAIM 011's threshold flag, and routes the filler to the claim
DECISIONS_TAKEN.alternatives_rejected: pre-fill the direction cells as the roadmap words them and stay silent
DECISIONS_TAKEN.who_consulted: CLAIM 011 and the receipt ledger, read not authored
DECISIONS_TAKEN.how_to_revert: delete the scaffold file; nothing depends on it
DECISIONS_TAKEN.why: a scaffold that imports a flagged phrasing would seed the flag into every card built from it

DECISIONS_TAKEN.what: the reconciliation uses a four-value verdict vocabulary and no fifth state
DECISIONS_TAKEN.alternatives_rejected: the external documents' own vocabulary (DA_APPROFONDIRE / APPROFONDITO / ADOTTATO NEL_PIANO / SCARTATO_CON_MOTIVO / IMPLEMENTAZIONE_VERIFICATA)
DECISIONS_TAKEN.why: that vocabulary describes the plan's own decisions; this document measures this host, and reusing it would blur exactly the adoption-versus-verification line the operator asked to keep visible. No new taxonomy was introduced anywhere else.
